subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should maintainers treat this as the canonical Control UI zh-CN tab-localization tracker and sequence the existing page-slice PRs through the generated i18n pipeline?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the remaining work spans multiple pages and overlapping contributor PRs, and UI AGENTS.md makes generated non-English bundles a pipeline-owned surface rather than a hand-edit sweep.

options.title: Keep canonical tracker
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate page-slice PRs, require English source keys plus regenerated locale metadata, and close only after the accepted Control UI surfaces are covered.

options.title: Supersede with broader localization epic
options.body: Move this issue under the broader zh-CN localization coverage issue and let that epic decide Control UI, CLI, runtime, and docs scope together.

options.title: Limit to one page slice
options.body: Narrow this issue to one unresolved tab and require separate issues for the other tabs and docs-site complaint.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate page-slice PRs, require English source keys plus regenerated locale metadata, and close only after the accepted Control UI surfaces are covered.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is most tied to the Control UI i18n source/generator pipeline history.
